title: Physics GNN Symbolic Discovery: A Self-Auditing Graph Neural Network for Classical Mechanics
description: A reproducible preprint and research package that represents classical mechanics as a typed graph of quantities, equations, and laws; trains an operator-conditioned graph neural network to reconstruct hidden quantities through held-out routes; compares it with a near-parameter-matched non-graph baseline; diagnoses dependence on node and edge features; and audits mined relationships against the encoded equation system and shifted sampling priors. The closed synthetic benchmark does not claim a new physical law.
